author: Manoranjan Sahoo / ମନୋରଞ୍ଜନ ସାହୁ
source_kind: Original Odia poem in local edition archive; not a translation
lyrics:
[Spoken word]
କାହାରି ପାଖରେ
ଅଟକି ଯାଏନି କେବେ
ଅନଳ ଭିତରୁ ବି ବାହାରି ଆସେ
ତୁମ
ହାତର
ବଂଶୀରେ
ବାଟ ହୁଡ଼ି ବସେ
ରହିଯାଏ
ଯେତେବେଳେ
ତୁମ ଓଠର ସ୍ପର୍ଶ
ତୁମ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିମାନ
ଛୁଇଁ ଚାଲିଥାଆନ୍ତି
ମତେ
ପୁନର୍ଜନ୍ମ ଲଭେ ।।
[End]
feedback: Very slow and too much eco, we need soft and sweet voice
scope: One revised pair of the same original Odia poem; no publication.
title: KBL · ପବନ · Soft sweet voice
style: Original Odia spoken poetry, soft, sweet female speaking voice with clear natural pronunciation. Gentle warmth, conversational pace and light, natural expression. Short pauses that follow meaning; connected phrases flow smoothly without stretching syllables. Clear, close, dry voice with no audible echo. Very faint, sparse piano beneath the narration, receding while the reader speaks. Read every word once, naturally and tenderly, with a simple quiet ending.
exclude: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, loud backing music, dense orchestration, overpowering bass, dramatic drops, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, melodic singing, chanting, rap, choir, backing vocals, vocoder, autotune effects, chopped vocals, heavy vocal echo, reverb, echo, delay, cavernous ambience, drawn-out syllables, exaggerated pauses, whispering, breathy vocals
change: Remove slow soulful direction, cinematic reverb, 70 BPM pulse and layered backing. Request soft sweet speaking voice, conversational pace, short meaning-led pauses, dry voice and faint sparse piano. Exact source verse preserved.
